thread:
jess: Noticing a handful of anchor failures after the mkdocs->docusaurus roll. Users hitting anchors in /guides/cluster and /guides/installer.
owen: Any examples?
jess: From support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/998  links to /guides/cluster#autoscaling but it lands at top.
tai: Ran the linkcheck job locally, output:
ERROR: Fragment not found: #autoscaling (in /guides/cluster)
Also a few that report as present in source but no slug produced.
priya: I pulled the generated HTML. In several cases headings were wrapped by a custom admonition component during migration, causing Docusaurus to compute a different slug.
jess: So two fixes possible: 1) add explicit IDs in the markdown; 2) add compatibility redirects so old links (blog posts, emails) keep working.
owen: For quick wins we should add explicit `{#id}` on high-traffic pages (installer, cluster, api/reference). Then a redirect map for everything else.
tai: Found a nasty conversion quirk where headings were indented and became fenced code in MDX. Example in installer.md (before):

    ### Quickstart
    Follow these steps...

After conversion that entire block is a code fence and produces no anchor.
priya: Ugh. Those need content edits (unindent). Redirects won't help if no heading exists.
docs-bot: linkcheck: nightly build 4348 detected 7 broken fragments. Details: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4348/linkcheck
jess: Plan: priya & tai will patch the top 10-most-hit pages with explicit IDs and fix indented headings. owen will prototype a slug-compat generator that compares prior slugs (from git) with current slugs and emits a redirects.json for docusaurus. I'll coordinate PR ordering so linkcheck passes.
owen: Prototype repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/tree/slugmap-proto. It currently emits a mapping like: {"/guides/cluster#old-autoscaling":"/guides/cluster#autoscaling"}. Needs heuristics for punctuation and unicode.
tai: I'll add a linkcheck unit to `.github/workflows/linkcheck.yml` that asserts anchors from a small compatibility list exist post-merge. That should catch regressions in future conversions.
priya: I'll sweep for indented heading patterns with this ripgrep: `rg "^\s{4,}#{1,6} " docs | sed -n '1,200p'` and open a PR for the fixes.
jess: Good. Also please add a one-line note in PRs: "explicit id added to preserve external link stability" so reviewers know intent.
owen: One more thought: enable docusaurus `onBrokenLinks: 'warn'` temporarily to avoid CI hard failures while we land mass fixes, then flip back after redirects in place. Thoughts?
tai: Makes sense for a short window, otherwise release cadence stalls. We'll coordinate with infra.
docs-bot: CI: created artifact with current slug list: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4348/slug-list.json
priya: Action list: Ill push installer/cluster patches today. owen -> PR for slugmap. tai -> linkcheck unit. Jess -> merge order & release note checklist update.
jess: Thanks team. Ping here when PRs are up and I'll run a manual linkcheck before merge.
